signals_info.description: Whether the associated intersection conflict area is occupied.

nl_Literal_translation_en: At some future time, the condition intersection_occupied == 1 shall cease to be true.
nl_Literal_translation_zh: 在未来某个时刻，intersection_occupied == 1 这一条件应刚停止成立。
nl_Paraphrase_en: The associated intersection conflict area shall become unoccupied at some future time.
nl_Paraphrase_zh: 关联路口的冲突区域应在未来某个时刻解除占用。
